result.title: Neural Compression over Equivalence Classes: Exact Gauges and Functional Rate-Distortion
result.summary: Neural networks admit many parameterizations of the same or nearly the same function, but deployment typically stores whichever parameter vector training happens to produce. We show that this representational freedom can itself be used for compression. Rather than redesigning the codec, we search over exact function-preserving transformations and controlled functional perturbations, using the unchanged physical compressor itself to select cheaper representations. Exact gauge families provide a zero-distortion reference under the strict audit; allowing small functional changes exposes much larger rate-distortion gains. Across SmolLM2 and Qwen3, our method reduces Zstandard-compressed checkpoint size by up to 23.4\%, with similar relative reductions under gzip, Brotli, and ZipNN, establishing trained-network representational freedom as a practical storage resource.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把神经网络同一函数存在多种参数化这一现象当作压缩资源，在精确保持函数的 gauge 变换族与受控函数扰动下搜索更低码率的等价表示，交由原压缩器决定取舍；在 SmolLM2 与 Qwen3 上使 Zstandard 压缩后的 checkpoint 体积最多减少约 23.4%，gzip、Brotli、ZipNN 下相对降幅相近。
AI.relevance_reason: 「函数等价类内的表示自由度」与「零失真／允许小失真的率失真分层」可能为判断 latent 状态能否在保持任务功能的前提下被压缩或抽象提供概念参照，但对象是权重存储而非推理期状态，需核查其等价性度量能否迁移到状态层面。
